notes.title: Isaac the Adventurer for Mac users!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone! 

As of today you can enjoy the game on your Mac. 

We are already compiling a list of all the stuff that we want to include in future updates so keep tuned for new announcements.

Have fun and enjoy the game!
